fullContentHtml:
Bihar BPSC APO Pre Final Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Pre Final Answer Key for the posts of Assistant Prosecution Officer (APO). This recruitment has been announced for 300 posts. The online application process for BPSC APO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 February 2026, to 20 March 2026. The Examination was conducted on 15 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for BPSC APO Pre Final Answer Key 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 February 2026
  • Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 March 2026
  • Exam Date : 15 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Available
  • Answer Key : 12 August 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 13 October 2026

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.

What is Bihar BPSC APO Pre Final Answer Key 2026?

Bihar BPSC APO Pre Final Answer Key 2026 contains the official answers. Candidates can verify their responses and submit objections if required.
